text: Look good have not yet tried, there are wire metal pieces that stick out on top though, not shown on picture.. I initially bought these ones because I did not have one at home and I remembered having these as a child mostly in my home pretty much a very similar or maybe even the exact same model, although when I looked at the package I realized it was only similar. For whatever reason at the top I saw that it had some small wires coming out, as I saw it this is normal but it takes off from the design and it doesn't look like that in the picture which makes it look a lot cheaper than it probably is and makes me scared that it might not be best quality. Other than that I have not yet tried them and I'm just hoping they will not break on me because of what I mentioned, for whatever reason it really scares me to break something like this... Also I did not notice it was a set containing 6 pieces and I even though it does say int he description I did not see it so I kinda hope that they maybe change the picture in the future so the 6 pieces are shown because it was a little confusing as they arrived and there were so many, I'm kinda glad there were more though but at the same time there's way too many.
